subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to documenting the existing pi-tui newline defaults, or should OpenClaw expose a first-class TUI send/newline keybinding preference?
rationale: The central multiline behavior is already dependency-backed, but a configurable TUI send/newline preference would add public config/API surface that repository policy says needs maintainer product judgment.

options.title: Document Existing Defaults
options.body: Add TUI docs and /help coverage for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash/fallback behavior while preserving dependency-owned keybindings.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Expose a narrow TUI send/newline preference with schema, help, docs, and focused PTY coverage after accepting the config/API maintenance cost.

options.title: Defer To Broader Editor Work
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide how it relates to external editor and vi-mode TUI editor requests.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Defaults
recommendation.body: Add TUI docs and /help coverage for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash/fallback behavior while preserving dependency-owned keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed this exact TUI boundary and have the strongest recent history across the TUI docs/runtime surfaces involved in the decision.
